rationale: The stock has already crashed 17.55% on a fundamental policy shock (dividend cuts, price controls, forced capex), and with only 27 minutes to close, the price is sitting at 90.7% of today's range near the session high — suggesting the bounce from $18.77 is largely exhausted. The risk/reward for a long is poor given the structural overhang from the news, and a short into a stock already near its intraday high with 27 minutes remaining and forced liquidation at close creates asymmetric risk of a squeeze. The mechanical setup does not offer a clean edge in either direction within this time window.
